title: Foreign Card Items and the Rounding of a Personal Checking Temporary Credit
content:
Two cases take the temporary credit on a Personal Checking account to a finer figure, read from the foreign card items standing on the account and from the owner's card payments under Personal Credit Cards.

- Where at least 2 foreign card items stand on the account **and** the owner has made at least 6 card payments in the last twelve months, the temporary credit is taken to the cent.
- Where the case above does not apply **and** either at least 4 such items stand **or** the owner has made at least 15 card payments in the last twelve months, it is taken in whole dollars, rounded half-up.
- Where neither case applies, the temporary credit is not taken to either of those finer figures.

**Worked rounding on hypothetical inputs.** Take a figure of 161.50 before rounding.

| Owner's position | Temporary credit |
|---|---|
| 3 foreign card items standing, 8 card payments in the last twelve months | 161.50 |
| 3 foreign card items standing, 2 card payments | Neither limb of the second case is met on these figures |
| 5 foreign card items standing, 2 card payments | 162.00 |
| 1 foreign card item standing, 16 card payments | 162.00 |
| 1 foreign card item standing, 3 card payments | Neither case applies |

The first case requires both of its limbs; the second is met by either limb alone. Equality satisfies each threshold, so exactly 2 items standing with exactly 6 card payments reaches the first case, and exactly 4 items standing reaches the first limb of the second.
